record.edic_text:
376 anaperos {an-ap'-ay-ros}

from 303 (in the sense of intensity) and peros (maimed);; adj

AV - maimed 2; 2

1) disabled in the limbs, maimed, crippled
2) injured in, or bereft of, some member of the body
